description: This file defines the UtilityService class, an Android IntentService that manages background operations such as clearing notifications, communicating with wearable devices, and starting device activities within the xyzTouristAttractions app.

classes.name: UtilityService
classes.description: An Android IntentService that handles background operations such as notification management, device communication, and starting activities on connected wearable devices.

methods.name: clearNotification
methods.description: Static method to clear the local notification by ID.

methods.name: clearRemoteNotifications
methods.description: Static method to initiate clearing of notifications on remote connected devices.

methods.name: getClearRemoteNotificationsIntent
methods.description: Static method to create an intent for clearing remote notifications.

methods.name: startDeviceActivity
methods.description: Static method to start a device activity via message to wearable device, with path and info about the tourist attraction.

methods.name: onHandleIntent
methods.description: Handles incoming intents based on their action to perform notification clearing or start device activities.

methods.name: clearNotificationInternal
methods.description: Clears the local notification using NotificationManager.

methods.name: clearRemoteNotificationsInternal
methods.description: Connects to GoogleApiClient and sends messages to all connected nodes to clear notifications.

methods.name: startDeviceActivityInternal
methods.description: Connects to GoogleApiClient, retrieves capability info, and sends message to relevant nodes to start an activity.
